reviews.text: I am glad that they are an option for weekend care.  They got the job done when I had to take my dog in for an eye issue.  The veterinarian explained the situation thoroughly and competently.   I think that customer confidence would be improved if the access point and lobby were more professional.  That could be achieved by having someone staff the front desk at all times so clients can come in and be greeted.  I called in advance and waited for them to bring me in.  However, when I was waiting two other clients came in on their own and no one was in front.  This could also be a safety issue for the staff / clients.   Also, a little "spruce up" and cleaning of the waiting area would go a long way.  It would not take much to be a nicer environment to help calm people and pets who are stressed.

I was in yesterday with my little guy Titus after he got sick. It took them a while, sure, but they had a LOT of patients come in & they were incredibly thorough with my pup, which I’m really grateful for because he’s an old baby. From start to finish they were great. I called yesterday afternoon after every other urgent care was too full & they got me an appointment right away, they told me how to access the building, & came out quickly to get my guy. The tech was not only amazing but so adorable & made me feel very comfortable leaving my highly anxious boy. She was so funny & so compassionate. She worked an extra few hours overtime & still was just as sweet & compassionate. The vet was so thorough & intelligent & made me feel so much better. I hope I don’t HAVE to come back because I hope my animals don’t get sick again but if I do have to, I know they’re in good hands. Thank you guys! Titus says sorry for the theatrics & showing you his singing/ screaming voice.
Very accommodating with appointments and urgent care!!!

Our dog got sick and started acting unlike himself on a weekend, and with his regular vet completely booked, we were referred here. They were amazing. They were able to get us in almost immediately, we dropped him off and we were called multiple times with thorough updates after each exam they conducted. They treated him and let us know what was going on and we felt so much better. Thank you to Dr Peterson for being so kind, knowledgeable, and thorough with our dog. We could not be more thankful! He is feeling so much better thanks to this vet.

UPDATE: The staff got back to me and sent all of my files over. While I appreciate them getting all my documentation sent, it is a bit too late. I understand their hours as an urgent care differ than typical hours, but I spent an entire evening attempting to call during their hours and never got through to them. They also stated they had sent the files but I didn't receive them bc they had my email incorrect-- I reached to them via email with no response, so I am not sure if this is accurate. Like I stated, all of the staff were kind and transparent and the doctor was helpful, however, not receiving documents and xray images is ket for continuity of care and myself and the other hospital did not recieve them until 3 days later which is very problematic.

Initial:
Don’t go here. While the staff were kind, they took X-rays we needed but when I transferred hospitals they never sent over the X-rays. I spent an entire day trying to get hold of them by phone and email to get the images transferred. No answer or response. You can’t walk in either. So now I’m having to have all the X-rays redone.

I was so stressed out over my little gremling, he is difficult and we have had bad experiences, I called vca urgent care about 4 times and every single time Krystal was AMAZING beyond what I can express. She was not only very knowledgeable, but compassionate and understanding. She guided me, reassured me that they were not only able to handle a fearful aggressive dog, but that it was not a problem at all. She didn’t rush me even when I called several times, was very kind and I would highly recommend this place to anyone needing quality care. THANK YOU KRYSTAL❤️🐶

Nice to have a place for urgent care that isn’t emergency. They take your pet from your car and you don’t go in. I recommend asking for an estimate so that you know exactly what to expect in terms of pricing and fully understand your options. They were willing to talk through the estimate with me. They did mention I would have instructions on meds that I already had at home when I picked up my kitty, however they did not provide these, so make sure you leave with everything you are expecting. Updating review. Ended up having to take my cat somewhere else after. They were much better at working with my cat’s anxiety at the other place. At the end of the day I would recommend a different place.

This place is horrible and very unprofessional. I took my dog here because he had an injury to his leg. We had to wait in the alley to fill paperwork out, paid for the exam. The doctor couldn’t even tell us what was wrong with him and she assumed we were having financial issues when we never once mentioned anything about financial issues. I felt insulted and thought this was very unprofessional to assume something like that. Don’t take your pets here.

We brought our cat to San Diego Veterinary Urgent Care after discovering a foxtail stuck up her nose. The staff was kind, compassionate, and able to see us quickly. They explained everything clearly and took great care of our kitty.

The prices were very reasonable compared to other emergency clinics, and we appreciated the excellent care we received. We highly recommend San Diego Veterinary Urgent Care to anyone needing urgent care for their pet!

It speaks volumes when my cat with trauma feels safe in a veterinary care space, one of her biggest triggers. I brought my cat in after she had dental surgery at a different vet a few days ago, as she was developing some concerning symptoms. My cat trusted the vet and the team to fully comply with an assessment of her mouth, for which the team sang her praises as this is not always the case with cats. The vet easily identified that a tooth fragment had been left in my poor baby's mouth, and was able to safely remove it without causing any additional pain or need for sedation. They completed this exam, administered pain/antibiotics/fluid injections, and sent her home with antibiotics and pain medications-all in less than a few hours, with exceptional communication, and under $500!! I am SO grateful I found them, and that I have them as a resource if my babies ever need urgent care in the future. 💛 Thank you for making a stressful situation feel a lot more manageable!

I brought my senior dog in for an emergency removal of a foxtail in his nasal cavity. The staff were attentive, kind, compassionate, and knowledgeable. He was seen for his initial exam within 30 minutes. I was provided with a treatment plan and a reasonable estimated cost range (the final bill came in at the low end of the range). Additionally, they diagnosed and treated a secondary issue he was having with his eye. The whole ordeal took under four hours and my dog was able to come home the same night. Thank you Dr. Campbell and everyone at SDVUC for taking such great care of my best friend.

Wow. Where do I start- To begin, I was quoted near $1800 for my cats initial exam. After discussing my budget, that was dropped down to near $1200 and some less important or time sensitive services were removed. My cat was in critical condition. I then received a call stating I would need to hospitalize my cat, costing $3000-$5000. When I said I could not afford this, I was met with 0 compassion, 0 empathy, I was told to either pay it and get him help, put him down, or take him home and “he won’t last long” is what they said. When I stated I would take him to a vet in Tijuana, I was met with passive aggressiveness, with them calling it “The Mexican Vet”. It was crystal clear I would need all of his medical documentation to take to the next doctor. After days of waiting on results for my cat (paying $147 in TJ for what would have costed $5000 in the USA), the TJ vet told me the documentation I gave them was incomplete. I was not given the bloodwork results, or the radiograph that I paid for. This is $520 in services at a time that they knew I spent my last cent with them to save my cat, and they neglected to even provide it. When I called them, I was told it should have been given to me and they would write up the employee who didn’t give them to me. Nothing was said about a refund. The vet then sent me the urinalysis and I had to call AGAIN to request the bloodwork. I then called again, to be sent FIVE BLANK EMAILS. I was told they were having a problem with their new lab testing program and that they’d scan the documents and send them over. When sent, they sent me incomplete bloodwork, duplicating part of the report and leaving out an entire half.  When I called back to discuss my frustration and ask for a refund given I needed to now pay for all of this again, I was met with a shouting receptionist calling me disrespectful (when I’m obviously in a moment of distress scrambling to get my cat the help he needs), told that I should be appreciative of them helping me when I couldn’t afford it (they did something free) and I was hung up on. DO NOT GO TO THIS VET. They are only interested in your money, and to top it off, they were going to have me put him down due to me not being able to afford their RIDICULOUS pricing. 520$ total for bloodwork and a radiograph, and neither one was delivered, but I get hung up on as my cat is dying in front of me? Now they won’t answer my calls. I have filed a dispute with my bank as well as making a report with the California Veterinary Medical Board.

The attached documents show the several failed emails, and the amount of attempts it took just for me to receive incomplete bloodwork documents- missing the CBC.

RESPONSE:

The amount of dishonesty in your response to my review tells me every single thing I needed to know. First off, my cat is a male. Second, I took him to Mexico directly following your doctor rushing me to decide whether to put him down or put him in a hospital when I spent the last of my money on his test results.

I called the office to request tha lab results that were indeed missing, as what should have been double sided or two pages was missing the entire second page + additional lab tests results.

Your veterinarian knew I could not afford an emergency vet in America, and I said I was taking HIM to Mexico, and she actually advised against it when that’s the only reason my cat survived.

I am happy to get the veterinarian that explained to me where you guys dropped the ball, and post their explanation here as well.

When my cat was laying on a hospital bed about to die, I called you for the missing results, and I was sent FIVE blank emails with nothing but a period. In a moment of frustration and stress, I told the person on the phone this is unacceptable, which it was, and they immediately treated me like I was being abusive rather than owning up to their mistakes.

I was even told the person who didn’t include the results was being disciplined, so not sure where or how you guys came up with the response you did. But anyways, Sylvester’s life was saved without u
Not affordable felt overcharged. Go somewhere else if your on a budget. Affordable is in the name but it is definitely not they charge double .
Don’t like deceitful ads

My Frenchie Louie had a sever skin problem. The staff was fantastic! Friendly ,fast, and really cared about Louie. He's doing great now. 5+ stars and affordable (About half the price I was quoted elsewhere)
I had a great experience here. Check-in was fast, the wait time was short, and the medical team was very kind and professional. They made a stressful situation much easier.
Really kind reception and staff, got me in right away to check on my older dog who wasn’t eating. Didn’t push tests but gave good follow up recommendations.

San Diego Veterinary Urgent care has taken fabulous care of our cat Steve multiple times now and urgently gotten him in after having a scary blockage. They have been great at communicating with us while he is under their care as well. It’s so nice to have such an attentive team located so closely to us.

Definitely recvoment this Urgent Care. My pet was treated and home in 2 hours. I’ve never had an emergency with my cat treated so fast. She needed bloodwork and some medication. SHe’s feeling much better now.
Great team. They squeezed us in and took great care of our pet. In-house services made it easy to get answers within 4–5 hours after dropping her off.

Had a great experience this Holiday weekend. You never want your pet to have an emergency but the prices were much less than what the 24 hours places told me. I am very thankful for them.

Had another visit here last night. I'm very thankful and so happy they were here when I needed them.

I want to give this place two stars.I would have given it one, but the staff are all very friendly and helpful. Now, the reason why I am leaving a review is because the name of the clinic is very deceptive.They are not affordable. Taking into consideration the area in which they are located.I can probably understand that the rent is very high.However, that doesn't give you the right to pass those prices onto the customer. I did my research, and I found out that a typical x ray for an animal in the entire united states is anywhere from 200 to 300. This place wanted 700.00$. They also wanted to charge me 300.00 dollars for blood work on top of the 140.00 visit. And that's before they even do any work on my cat. Do not be deceived by the name. It's a shame how they lure people in with that name knowing that they are nowhere near affordable. With that $1140.00, I can hire a company to put up the letters UN in front of their sign in the hope that nobody has to waste their time.

Would I recommend this pet ER to anybody? NO
Why: they charged me $2,097  just to run blood test and x-rays on my cat. On top of that, I’m concerned about what they did to my cat.
My cat is very docile and quiet. Barely hisses or growls at anyone. When I went to pick him up, he was the polar opposite of that. He screeched when I went to touch him. He’s never acted like that.
They gave him some form of tranquilizer because he was too stressed to let them do blood work. My theory is that they gave him too much. I never want to see my cat like that again.

For $2,097 you get blood work, x-rays, and a traumatized fur baby that was given too much drugs. I would stay away from this place completely.

I asked for them to give my boy some water and they did not give him any, for over 3 hours!! They said he was nauseous but never threw up! He was foaming at the mouth because he was THIRSTY, and anxious! How do you say you will give him water and don't! I will never return!

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. If I could give negative stars I would. this urgent care completely misdiagnosed my cat with feline diabetes after a single glucose test and sent me home with insulin which could have KILLED my cat if I had followed their instructions. Thankfully I consulted the internet and a facebook group dedicated to helping diabetic cat owners told me to get the right test called frustosomine. Cats will "glucose purge" under stress and that is why their flaky test came back with high blood sugar. Any properly trained vet should know this. Argh. so frustrated that I wasted my money and stressed my cat out for this horrible service. My cat doesn't have diabetes and never did.

Took my pet to be taken care for a broken nail. They wanted to charge me $1,060 dollars which is unbelievable. They also charged me $140 just to check on her. They are very abusive with their prices I ended up taking her somewhere else and they couldn’t even but a bandage on her nail that was bleeding. Also they charged my card before even handing me my dog that is super un respectful.
I've taken 3 of my cat here to get their spayed and neutered. Busy, but pets still are cared for .

they charged me $1250 just to clean an infected wound on my cat without breaking down the charges (I had to ask what the charges were for). And then when I asked for an itemized receipt to explain the charges suddenly it was $650. I was waiting outside for 30 minutes even with an appointment as vets came in and out. I ended up paying $950 because they convinced me to get blood work done for $350 (this was completely unnecessary) These vets are ripping you off. My cat was put under sedation to clean a wound. It wasn't wrapped up and she wasn't going under surgery but still 1250 just to put a cone on her head. I'm shocked and extremely dissatisfied at the care of this facility.
Bad with appointments time and unprofessional service

I had to take my cat in for an emergency visit.  I was treated wonderfully.  They were very compassionate, kind, and concerned about me and my cat. I was kept informed about the costs, recommended procedures, and the well-being of my cat. I would definitely recommend this veterinarian hospital to anyone who truly cares about the health and treatment of their pet.

Had a wonderful experience with Dr. martinez and her team. Our 2O week old kitten pulled a large plant over on herself and injured her leg. We feared it was broken. The VCA ER had a three hour wait and they recommended this urgent care. We called and they told us to bring her right over. They were so warm and caring, clearly as concerned about our kitten as we were. They were professional, excellent listeners and communicated clearly. They emailed the xrays to us and the vet reviewed them with us over the phone, reassuring us that there were no breaks or dislocations, and it was likely a bruise. They gave us some light pain meds for us, sending them and her records home in this adorable bag they made just for her. We brought or kitten to them in a basket with a towel over it because it’s all we had and they gave us a free heavy duty cardboard carrier to bring her home in. Hope to never need a veterinary urgent care in the future but will definitely use them if we do. Going to check and see if Dr. Martinez works anywhere else for regular veterinary care!
This urgent care was absolutely fantastic. They worked around the clock to save a previous member of my family and nothing I can do would repay them for all the kindness they have showed. …
Our dog stepped on a bee, and needed care for a minor reaction. We were able to be seen quickly, and her treatment plan was well communicated during her stay. All in all, a very easy vet visit.

This urgent care is in a pretty horrible location. The parking situation sucks and the way they intake your pets is even worse, handing over your pet through the back door. Didn’t even get seen and was “diagnosed” through the phone. Will not come back or suggest this urgent care.

They were fast and helped my dog with foxtails. Unsure if they got it all but it was quick. Price wise i did find it odd it was 45 dollars for the amoxxicilin for a weeks worth which seemed weirdly high as it doesnt appear to be that much anywhere else but i love my boy and he needed the medicine.

Every Wednesday, these vets have a walk-in vaccine clinic from 1 to 2. The prices are very reasonable and no extra hidden fees show up on the bill. Charge cards do pay an extra $3 which is posted in the room. Enter from the parking lot. GREAT VETS!
